summary: The MaintCampus system is designed as a web application for managing campus records. It includes functionalities for viewing, adding, editing, deleting, and reactivating campus data. The application employs ASP.NET web controls, data binding, and event handling to facilitate management operations.
purpose: To manage campus data by allowing users to add, edit, delete, and view records in a web-based interface.

workflows.name: Manage Campus Records
steps: User selects a department from the dropdown.
System refreshes data based on selection.
User can choose to add, edit, or delete campus records.
System validates inputs and updates database accordingly.
Changes are reflected in the grid view.

business_rules: Only users with proper access rights can modify campus data.
validations: Name and ShortName are required fields.
Maximum length for Name is 50 characters.
Maximum length for ShortName is 10 characters.
conditions: The screen is editable only if user has appropriate permissions.
system_behavior: Auto-populates agency and department dropdowns on page load.
Grid view updates dynamically upon data changes.
exceptions: If user does not have edit rights, edit buttons are disabled.
Error and warning panels display messages based on system events.
